plain.li: In the dream I was running across the fields, and my legs did everything I asked of them.
Dreamt I carried a whole load of stone up the hill, and set it down, and went back for another.
Dreamt it was the first warm day of spring, and I walked out past the last field just to see what was there.
[child] I could run faster than anyone, even the dogs.

warm.li: Dreamt I was well again and went around to each of their doors with something I'd made.

blunt.li: Running dream. Legs aren't ready. Will be.

cheerful.li: In the dream I climbed onto the roof just because I could. Can't wait to do it awake.

gloomy.li: I was well in the dream, and the others had already forgotten I'd been ill. I wasn't sure I liked that.

cold.li: A dream of full strength. A reasonable forecast, given the rate of recovery.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the long bed

plain.li: My bed was in the middle of the yard, and the whole colony went about its day around me.
The bed went on and on, longer every time I tried to reach the end of it.
The seasons changed outside the window while I lay there, spring, summer, snow, all in one night.
[child] My bed grew legs and walked me all around the colony to say hello.

warm.li: Dreamt that everyone took turns sitting by my bed, all night, and none of them were tired.

blunt.li: Bed dream. Done with the bed.

gloomy.li: In the dream they forgot I was there, and went on without me.

cold.li: Lay in bed in my dream, too. My mind is as bored as the rest of me.

plain.li: In the dream the work piled up at the foot of my bed, higher every hour, and nobody would let me touch it.
At my bench in the dream, and my hands wouldn't close around the tools. They were clenched when I woke.
Dreamt everyone else was doing my work, badly, and smiling at me about it.

blunt.li: Dreamt about work. Can't do it yet. Hate that.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the colony managed perfectly well without me. Worst dream I've had all year.

cold.li: A dream about the backlog. Accurate, unfortunately.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the patient walking

plain.li: Dreamt my patient got up from the bed, folded the blanket and walked out into the sun. I stood in the doorway and watched.
In the dream every bed in the sickroom was empty and made up, and I could finally sit down.
The fever broke in my own hands, like a stick snapping, and the room went cool.

warm.li: Dreamt everyone I've ever pulled through came to supper, and nobody said a word about being ill.

blunt.li: Dreamt the patient lived. Did. Good dream.

cheerful.li: Best dream in ages: my patient challenged me to a race, and won.

gloomy.li: Dreamt my patient lived. I keep waiting for the other kind of dream.

cold.li: A dream reviewing the case. The treatment was correct.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the empty bed

plain.li: In the dream I was still tending them, and they kept asking for something I couldn't find on any shelf.
Dreamt I could see what I should have done, all of it, clear as day. By morning it had gone muddy again.
The bed was empty and still warm, and I kept laying out the medicine anyway.

warm.li: Dreamt they told me it wasn't my fault. I wanted to believe them more than anything.

gloomy.li: Every patient I've lost was in the dream, waiting quietly in a line.

cold.li: The dream went through every step of the treatment. I still can't find the mistake. Perhaps there wasn't one.

plain.li: All night I counted the medicine on the shelf, and the number came out different every time.
A book that explained exactly how to cure it, and the pages went blank as I turned them.
My patient's fever was a fire in the hearth, and I kept carrying water to it.

warm.li: Dreamt the patient's mother sat at the foot of the bed knitting, and with every row she finished the fever went down.

blunt.li: The case, all night. Still the case.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I ran out of medicine. Went to count the shelf before breakfast.

cold.li: Dosing tables, all night. Nothing new in them.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the first cry

plain.li: Dreamt of the first cry again, the one that means everything is all right. I heard it right through the night.
In the dream the baby looked straight at me, as if it knew who I was.
All the babies I've delivered, grown, walking past me in the yard, and not one of them knew.

warm.li: Dreamt I held the baby while the mother slept, and the whole colony was quiet so as not to wake them.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the birth. Went well, both times.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the baby grew up to be a doctor and told me I was doing it all wrong. Wonderful dream.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the birth, and was afraid all the way through, until the cry.

cold.li: A dream about the delivery. Uncomplicated, as it was.
